{"claims":[{"claim_text":"All American workers deserve workplaces that are safe, healthy, and fair.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Republican Congress have supported efforts to improve workplace safety without burdening businesses with costly and unnecessary regulations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Overall workplace fatalities and injuries are at record low levels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American workers deserve fair wages for hours spent working overtime.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"1.3 million additional workers now have guaranteed overtime protections as a result of Republican efforts to modernize labor laws left untouched since 1949.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Regulations explicitly guarantee overtime protection to blue collar workers, police, firefighters, EMTs, factory workers, construction workers, and licensed practical nurses, among others, for the first time.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Clearly defined overtime rules will lead to a greater understanding of rights and responsibilities for employees and employers.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Workers who pay dues through their workplace deserve to know how their dues are being used, especially when the money is being used to support political activity.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans have enhanced financial disclosure requirements for political campaigns, corporations, and pension funds in order to bring about more transparency and accountability in the political system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Bush Administration improved union financial disclosure forms to offer union members more information about how their dues money is spent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Management and unions should find common ground to ensure economic viability for both.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
